entities.title: processes
entities.summary: Conventions, templates and tools for software development processes in general, not tied to any one system, written down so that agents as well as people follow them.
entities.purpose: The repository root holds the conventions in project-management/, the skills and knowledge catalogue its own .dev files follow in Meta/Agents/, and the README a reader starts from. Each convention is meant to be copied into, or linked from, another repository.
boundaries: Nothing here is built, run or deployed: the folders hold Markdown documents and templates, and Meta/Agents holds the validators the .dev files are checked with.
Meta/Agents/Skills and Meta/Agents/Knowledge are copies of Agents/Skills and Agents/Knowledge in the human-assisted-software-development repository, changed there and copied here.
The agent skills and the page that draws .dev folders used to live here and now live in other repositories; the README links to them.
